basis: measured A preview / B NVENC 6000k 1080p30 recording / C recording + 3 local gpt-oss probe calls / D recording + 3 hosted probe calls; OBS 'Full shot' (face cam, c922 + chroma key, SplitCam feed, MOM Three browser overlay); gpt-oss-20b resident in LM Studio

executor_static_limits.concurrency: one active experiment, one container at a time, one resident local model, one GPU generation slot
